title: Web UI foundation

context.summary: Create the first supported Web UI package with token entry, API client, health banner and project/session navigation foundations.
context.background: HTTP API, CLI and MCP are already supported surfaces. The public-ready plan requires a first-class Web UI before final public readiness.

in: Create apps/ui as a workspace package that builds in the repository typecheck path.
Add a browser UI with API URL/token entry, persisted local settings and redacted token display.
Add an API client for health, projects, peers, sessions and messages.
Add project/session navigation with loading, empty and error states.
Add a runtime health banner and read-only connection diagnostics.
Add config/docs validation for the UI foundation and local development commands.
out: Document upload and job workspace UI, which is TASK-127.
Search, context, memory and faces UI, which is TASK-128.
Runtime settings and diagnostics UI, which is TASK-129.
Docker image/service and installer routing integration, which is TASK-130.

acceptance_criteria: apps/ui exists as a workspace package with a TypeScript build and no unsupported placeholder UI.
The UI includes token/API URL entry, stored connection state, health banner, project list, session list and selected session message list.
The UI API client uses HTTP API routes only and does not access database, queue, storage or worker internals.
Loading, empty, 401/403 and generic error states are visible and actionable.
The root typecheck and pnpm check include the UI package and a UI foundation validator.
README and docs describe how to build and run the UI foundation.

manual_checks: The UI is a real browser app foundation; document upload/search pages remain scoped to later tasks.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
